title: Carrier Program Performance Standards under the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
Referral commitments of the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements. These figures are set for the Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement; every other tier carries zero commitments and no referable loss types.

| Tier | Insured contacted within (hours after referral) | Crew on site for an emergency loss within (hours after referral) | Estimate uploaded to the carrier within (calendar days after referral) | Loss types the carrier may refer | Scorecard minimum (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement | 2 | 24 | 3 | water, sewer backup, fire, smoke, mold | 90 |
| Ready Profile Service Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | 0 |
| Silver Priority Service Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | 0 |
| Gold Priority Service Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | 0 |
| Platinum Priority Service Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | 0 |
| Portfolio Master Service Agreement | 0 | 0 | 0 | none | 0 |

## Standard by standard

1. **Contact commitment**: hours after a carrier referral by which the insured is contacted.
2. **On-site commitment**: hours after a carrier referral by which a crew is on site for an emergency loss.
3. **Estimate upload commitment**: calendar days after a carrier referral by which the estimate is uploaded to the carrier.
4. **Referable loss types**: the loss types the carrier may refer under the agreement.
5. **Scorecard minimum**: the minimum carrier scorecard percentage of referrals meeting every commitment in a quarter before the carrier review.

## Reading the standards

- Under the Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement, a referral meets every commitment when the insured is contacted within 2 hours, a crew is on site within 24 hours where the loss is an emergency loss, and the estimate is uploaded within 3 calendar days.
- A quarter in which a hypothetical 88 percent of a carrier's referrals met every commitment falls below the 90 percent minimum; a hypothetical 92 percent does not.
